title: When the Tryouts Turns
author: Emrys Nakamura
blurb: Juniper Brightwater, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
